bestowals.vote_detail: Shared. Seymour Almasy and Saij tied on 13 votes each of the 43 cast, and were declared co-holders of the award. Argyle took nominations by private message through November 2004 ("Character, not handler"; one to three picks, each with reasons), short-listed the five characters nominated more than once, and counted a private ballot sent to him by private message. Third was AWS Man (also known as Bill), then Jason Hughes, then Chris Storm. Each winner was promised a splash image in the site's random rotation.
bestowals.source: PTC forum, Announcements: "Winner - Ptc Wrestler Of The Year..." (topic 11833, post 124777, Argyle, 19 Dec 2004: "Winner, the 2004 PTC Wrestler of the Year: Seymour Almasy and Saij, with 13 votes a piece. Thus, they are co-holders of the award. Total votes, 43."); "PTC Wrestler of the Year Shortlist - 5 Candidates!" (topic 11530, post 121714, 3 Dec 2004); E-Wrestling: "PTC's 2004 Wrestler of the Year" (topic 10886, post 112864, 2 Nov 2004, the call for nominations). PTCpedia's own PTC Wrestler of the Year page (/promotions/ptc/archive/ptcpedia-ptc-wrestler-of-the-year.html, captured 7 Mar 2008): "2004 Seymour Almasy and Saij tied scores in a public ballot." Also cited in commentary on the UWF's Contest of Champions 3 (promotions/uwf/archive/contest-of-champions-3-2005.html: "the co-PTC wrestler of the year").

bestowals.vote_detail: Chosen from 21 self-nominated characters by a ballot sent privately to Argyle, each vote required to give reasons including at least one feat the nominee had not listed; voting closed at midnight on 31 December 2005. Deville put his own case forward on the forum's 2005 nomination thread on 9 December 2005, and the result was billed for PTC Radio's first 2006 edition, in mid-January 2006. Fellow nominee Rich Rollins campaigned for the award in character with a hype video, posted on 30 December 2005 and re-uploaded to YouTube in 2007 as "PTC WOTY 2005 Rollins"; its claim of the award for Rollins is his own campaign's, and the ballot went to Deville.
bestowals.source: PTCpedia's own PTC Wrestler of the Year page (/promotions/ptc/archive/ptcpedia-ptc-wrestler-of-the-year.html): "2005 Angelo Deville won a public ballot." PTC forum, E-Wrestling, post 178618 (the nomination, 9 Dec 2005); Technology, post 185492 (Argyle, 4 Feb 2006: "Angelo Deville - PTC 2005 Wrestler of the Year"); Administration, post 188298 (Rich Rollins, PTC Global Champion, in character, 27 Feb 2006: "the 2005 Wrestler of the Year in Angelo Deville"). The ballot: E-Wrestling, "PTC Wrestler of the Year - 2005!  Stage 2 enclosed - VOTE NOW" (topic 16449, post 181159, Argyle, 24 Dec 2005: the 21 nominees and the voting rules); Announcements, "PTC Radio 2006 Edition 1 coming this Saturday night" (topic 16602, post 183149, 13 Jan 2006: "Tune in for: - 2005 Wrestler of the Year"); E-Wrestling, "PTC Wrestler of the Year 2007 - Nominations" (topic 22110, post 255544, Argyle, 2 Dec 2007: "previous WOTY winners the likes of Chryste (2003), Seymour Almasy and Saij (2004) and Angelo Deville (2005)"; "Rollins and Deville juiced it up for this in 2005, including making videos"). Rollins's video: PTC's Infinite Gauntlet, "The One Hype (PTC 2005 WOTY Nomination Hype Video)" (topic 16499, post 181774, 30 Dec 2005), re-uploaded to YouTube as "PTC WOTY 2005 Rollins" (video lKAGZauXcn4, uploaded 5 Dec 2007; its description: "This used to be on zippyvideos.").

bestowals.vote_detail: The first PTC Wrestler of the Year, decided by members' vote in the 2003 PTC Awards; by her own count, she took 11 votes, one more than double the runner-up's. The award earned her a splash image in the site's random rotation.
bestowals.source: PTCpedia's own PTC Wrestler of the Year page (/promotions/ptc/archive/ptcpedia-ptc-wrestler-of-the-year.html, captured 7 Mar 2008): "2003 Chryste won a public ballot." PTC forum, E-Wrestling: "PTC accomplishments" (topic 1238, post 11966, 17 Nov 2003, her own list of her PTC honours: "Wrestler of the Year (2003) With 11 votes (Double + 1 of Second place)"); "PTC's 2004 Wrestler of the Year" (topic 10886, post 112864, Argyle, 2 Nov 2004: the prize is a splash "similar to the one Chryste has acknowledging winning of the 2003 WOTY award"); E-Wrestling, "PTC Wrestler of the Year 2007 - Nominations" (topic 22110, post 255544, Argyle, 2 Dec 2007): "Chryste (2003)".

bestowals.vote_detail: No official award. Self-nominations opened on 16 February 2007 and closed at the end of that month; Argyle later wrote that there was no official 2006 Wrestler of the Year because the nominations were too few and too thin, and that Doctor Curiosity's handler "ended up awarding it to himself". Doctor Curiosity crowned himself PTC Wrestler of the Year 2006 in character on 2 May 2007, and PTCpedia carries him as the unofficial winner. Tchu disputed the claim in character in December 2007.
bestowals.source: PTCpedia's own PTC Wrestler of the Year page (/promotions/ptc/archive/ptcpedia-ptc-wrestler-of-the-year.html, captured 7 Mar 2008): "2006 No contest due to lack of effort. Unoffficial winner is Doctor Curiosity." PTC forum, E-Wrestling: "2006 Wrestler of the Year - Nominate Yourself Here" (topic 20195, post 225308, 16 Feb 2007); E-Wrestling, "PTC Wrestler of the Year 2007 - Nominations" (topic 22110, post 255544, Argyle, 2 Dec 2007): "We didn't have an official 2006 Wrestler of the year because the number of nominations received and the effort put into those was... lacklustre"; PTC's Infinite Gauntlet: "Wrestler of 'The Year'" (topic 20643, post 229101, 2 May 2007, Doctor Curiosity's own in-character crowning); "Is the Doctor in? 2006 WotY" (topic 22137, post 255853, Tchu, 7 Dec 2007).

bestowals.vote_detail: Nominations by private message to Argyle opened on 2 December 2007. No winner was declared: PTCpedia, captured in March 2008, gives 2007 as "To be determined". Clinton Sage's own handler posted on 28 March 2008 that Clinton Sage and Jason Snow "swept the votes", and in May 2008 that the two had "'unofficially' tied" for the award; that claim is his own.
bestowals.source: E-Wrestling, "PTC Wrestler of the Year 2007 - Nominations" (topic 22110, post 255544, Argyle, 2 Dec 2007); PTCpedia's own PTC Wrestler of the Year page (/promotions/ptc/archive/ptcpedia-ptc-wrestler-of-the-year.html, captured 7 Mar 2008): "2007 To be determined." E-Wrestling: "What's new" (topic 22796, post 262435, 28 Mar 2008: "Clinton Sage and Jason Snow swept the votes for 2007 PTC Wrestler of the Year. Swept."); "Just one ..." (topic 23074, post 265368, 6 May 2008: "the PTC 2007 Wrestler of the Year award that we've 'unofficially' tied for").

bestowals.vote_detail: A members' vote game on the forum. Billed "Angello Deville", he won the three-way final over Tempest and Trashcan Man, 5 votes to 3 to 2.
bestowals.source: PTC forum, E-Wrestling: "PTC Thunderdome (Taken from EWN)" (topic 10559, from 20 Oct 2004: two characters at a time, first to five votes, then a bracketed tournament), "PTC Thunderdome Tournament!" bestowals.vote_detail: A survivor-style prison roleplay game Argyle ran on the forum. Won the final round over Kevon Baker, seven votes to three.
bestowals.source: PTC forum, other Events: "Final Round Result" (topic 22101, post 255485, Argyle, 1 Dec 2007: "Thus, with a 7 vote to 3 lead, Angelo Deville takes out Death Row Inc!"); "The Inmates - an introduction" (topic 21534).
